items.prompt: What is the active participle of this verb?
items.explanation: From the bare verb, the active participle is on fāʿil: nāṣir.

items.prompt: What is the active participle of this verb?
items.explanation: From an added pattern: a mīm with ḍamma in place of the prefix, and a kasra before the last letter.
The kasra before the last letter makes it the active participle of akrama.
